messages:
jamie: Heads-up — seeing a ~3x p50/p95 spike on router-prod since 09:07 UTC. I opened a hotfix PR that reverts the conn-pool tweak. Can someone take a quick look and merge if safe? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/4823
alex_m: Looking now. Can you paste the smallest repro logs or the timeout traces? Also what's the rollback PR URL?
jamie: rollback PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/4824
jamie: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T09:06:58Z router-prod svc latency p95 1200ms -> 3500ms
2026-03-17T09:07:01Z router-prod error: upstream timeout (504) during connect
2026-03-17T09:07:05Z svc: spike correlated with new conn-pool param rollouts
```
marcus: Oncall note: let's canary this revert first. CI quick-suite passed on the PR run (build #4825).
deploy-bot: [ci] build passed — router#4825 — unit/integration ✅
sree: I can review in ~2m. If it's a straight revert and CI is green, I'm fine with merge+canary. Jamie, please assign me on the PR.
jamie: assigned @sree :thumbsup:
alex_m: Quick skim — change is just reverting a single config chunk, looks safe. Leaving an approval after one more line check.
alex_m: Approved by alex_m
sree: Approved by sree
jamie: merging to main now and kicking off canary deploy
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary deploy started — release router@rev-4823 — routing 5% traffic
marcus: watching metrics — p95 trending down already
jamie: p95 back around 300ms at 09:15 UTC, error rate returned to baseline. Will expand to 25% in 5m then 100% if stable :tada:
marcus: 👍
alex_m: thanks — nice catch and quick turnaround
jamie: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short postmortem on the cause + next steps for config gating.
